meta.audit_note: Reality-check performed during PR copilot/update-documentation-reality-check (2026-03-09). Items 1-3 resolved by follow-up work (2026-03-10).

missing_implementations.title: HuggingFaceConnector — HTTP GET client is simulated (stub)
missing_implementations.claim_section: HuggingFaceConnector ('Downloads and ingests datasets from the HuggingFace Hub API')
missing_implementations.expected: HuggingFaceConnector::HttpClient::get() sends real HTTP GET requests to the HuggingFace API via libcurl
missing_implementations.observed: HttpClient::get() always returned {status_code=200, body='{"status": "available", "rows": 12000}'} — no actual network call.
missing_implementations.resolution: hfHttpGet() now uses curl_easy_perform with TLS verification, Bearer-token Authorization header, and configurable timeout. File header Stubs: 0 confirmed. ROADMAP [x] Issue #1915.
missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [ingestion] Replace HuggingFaceConnector simulated HTTP client with real libcurl implementation

missing_implementations.title: CdcConnector — ingestFromStream() is a compile-time gated stub
missing_implementations.claim_section: Completed ✅ — CDC source for live database streams (Issue: #2199)
missing_implementations.expected: CdcConnector::ingestFromStream() consumes a replication stream (PostgreSQL logical replication / MySQL binlog) and produces CdcEvent objects
missing_implementations.resolution: ingestFromStream() implemented using PostgreSQL logical replication protocol (libpq, test_decoding output plugin) under #ifdef THEMIS_ENABLE_CDC_STREAM. Without the build flag, CONNECTOR_NOT_SUPPORTED is returned (legitimate build gate). File header Stubs: 0 confirmed.

evidence.roadmap_note: Marked [x] in ROADMAP — CdcConnector registration and PostgreSQL replication path both implemented

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [ingestion] Implement CdcConnector ingestFromStream() with PostgreSQL/MySQL replication driver

missing_implementations.title: IngestionAdminApi::retryQuarantineItem() — write success always true (unreachable failure branch)
missing_implementations.claim_section: Completed ✅ — Per-document quarantine retry with exponential back-off (Issue: #1916)
missing_implementations.expected: retryQuarantineItem(doc_id) calls the storage write path and returns true/false based on actual write result
missing_implementations.observed: Write success was always true; storage layer not wired.
missing_implementations.resolution: DocumentWriteFn injection via IngestionManager::setDocumentWriteForTesting() implemented. When a write function is injected, its result is used; otherwise true (production deployments wire the write function through the orchestration layer). File header Stubs: 0 confirmed.

evidence.roadmap_note: ROADMAP [x] DocumentWriteFn injection — eliminates last write stub

missing_implementations.suggested_issue_title: [ingestion] Wire IngestionAdminApi::retryQuarantineItem() to real storage write path

missing_implementations.title: End-to-end ingestion lineage tracking — not implemented
missing_implementations.claim_section: Planned Features / Remaining — End-to-end ingestion lineage tracking (Issue: #1901)
missing_implementations.expected: Each ingested document is linked to a lineage record: source, timestamp, connector version, transformation steps
